'''Shima''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was a [[witch]], and served as [[ensign]] and [[Advisor|adviser]] to [[Aniseya]] as part of a [[Brendok coven|coven]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Destiny" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shima was created for the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''. The character was performed by [[Deborah Rosan]].<ref name="Destiny" />
